definitions.gloss: being selected, being accepted for exhibition or publication
definitions.explanation: Having one's work selected for display, exhibition, or inclusion in a competition. Commonly used for art exhibitions, photography contests, literary competitions, and similar juried selections.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦コンテスト→コンテスト：03843_kontesuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入選|にゅうせん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My photo was selected for the contest.

examples.japanese: {入選|にゅうせん}⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Selected works will be displayed at the art museum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{応募|おうぼ}→応募：03014_oubo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{文学賞|ぶんがくしょう}→文学賞：22097_bungakushou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入選|にゅうせん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised when the first novel I submitted was selected for the literary prize.

notes:
Focuses on the act of being chosen or accepted by a panel or jury, rather than winning a top prize. Often the first step before potentially winning an award.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入選|にゅうせん}⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧ (selected work)
- {入選|にゅうせん}⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (selected entrant)
- {入選|にゅうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧ (achieve selection)
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入選|にゅうせん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (be selected for ~)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入選|にゅうせん}: being selected/accepted (from among submissions — emphasizes passing the selection process)
- ⟦{入賞|にゅうしょう}→入賞：11670_nyuushou⟧: winning a prize (achieving a ranked placement)
- ⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧: winning (a lottery, election)
